consultasBanco.descricao: Retrato DEPOIS da NAY: nada mudou (prazos, versões, checklist, dossiês); só ai_runs registra as execuções
consultasBanco.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM legal.legal_deadlines WHERE legal_case_id = :caso) AS prazos, (SELECT count(*) FROM legal.contract_versions WHERE contract_id = :ct) AS versoes, (SELECT string_agg(status, ',' ORDER BY id) FROM legal.contract_requirements WHERE contract_id = :ct) AS checklist, (SELECT count(*) FROM legal.evidence_packages WHERE legal_case_id = :caso) AS dossies, (SELECT count(*) FROM ai.ai_runs WHERE agent_name = 'NAY_JURIDICA' AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour') AS execucoes_nay
